descriptive_common_composition_standardi.definition: Within strata having both reference groups, use the pooled adjudicated+corroborated stratum record fractions as the same weights for each group's held-out rate. PASS_UNCORROBORATED records are excluded from these weights. This arithmetic reweighting is descriptive and is not a causal adjustment or error-rate estimate.

limitations: All 487 original records were already selected for certificate availability; the analysis estimates no detection recall or false-refutation prevalence in unselected proofs.
The 449-record replication frame is conditional on the reference gate; the two campaigns are not independent random samples from the 487 records.

Reference-adjudicated status is a prior response to disagreements, not a randomized treatment. Its association with later holdout may reflect claim difficulty, modeling choices, provenance, and different gate strictness.
Replication holdout combines NEEDS_REPAIR and FAIL, including missing source provenance and incompatible adjudication labels; it is not equivalent to a mathematically false witness.
Witness CONFIRMED is the existing isolated auditor's verdict. This analysis reruns no witness checker or Lean compilation and does not elevate its trust tier.
PARTIAL and MISMATCH are both non-MATCHES in binary tables; all original outcome categories are retained in accompanying categorical tables.
Historical 38/38 QEDBench blind rediscovery is separate from final release admission. The core source population is 38 originally, 37 in the handoff, and 31 finally released.
Repeated source problems, reused certificates, related obstruction families and model-family audit errors can create dependence; no confidence intervals, p-values or causal claims are reported.
The quarantined already-published-counterexample stratum remains included with its original label; neither all-401 counts nor distinct strings establish novelty.
Raw and whitespace-normalized text identity are deliberately syntactic. No keyword-based semantic taxonomy, graph isomorphism, or proof-equivalence judgment is inferred.

scope: Existing frozen audit outcomes and exact artifact identities; no new mathematical or semantic adjudication.

source_and_text_identity.interpretation: Text equality or file reuse does not establish mathematical equivalence; text inequality does not establish mathematical novelty or independent counterexamples. Certificate hashes are the frozen manifest's stored hashes, not a fresh recompilation or on-disk certificate audit.
source_and_text_identity.normalization: re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip(); case, punctuation, Unicode math symbols and all non-whitespace characters are preserved.

source_grouping_rules.artifact_id_alias: Within file contents only, replace the legacy literal 'Graph Theory' with 'Graph_Theory' before validating against the exact manifest/file stem. No other record-ID aliases are admitted.
source_grouping_rules.arxiv_id_without_version: Strip version and import suffix; legacy math_NNNNNNN becomes math/NNNNNNN.
source_grouping_rules.mse_question_id: mse_QUESTION__ansANSWER -> stackexchange:math:QUESTION, sharing the same namespace as SE_math.
source_grouping_rules.proofwiki_numeric_source_id: Remove proofwiki_ prefix and optional __codex_expansion suffix; retain the numeric ID.
source_grouping_rules.qedbench_problem_prefix: Keep Algorithms_N or Graph_Theory_N before __, merging all solution IDs including legacy suffixes.
source_grouping_rules.reddit_global_post_id: reddit_SUBREDDIT_POSTID -> reddit:POSTID; subreddit is omitted because Reddit post IDs are global identifiers.
source_grouping_rules.unit_definition: A benchmark problem, Stack Exchange question, Reddit post, ProofWiki numeric source record, or version-stripped arXiv paper identifier. These heterogeneous source units are grouping proxies, not certified distinct mathematical problems or independent observations.
source_grouping_rules.unknown_record_rule: Fail with an error; do not silently assign singleton IDs.
